notes.title: Unbenannt
notes.notes:
Hello community,
A lot has happened since This Game is Crap came online. I am now studying computer science in Leipzig and working as a developer. There is currently a Kickstarter campaign for the Giebichenstein dream project. I would cautiously describe the probability of success as low. I'll attach it at the back anyway. What I'm currently working on is a small but, I think, unprecedented text RPG that I'll definitely finish next year. Here are a few impressions.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41247744/d899a8cdc757a1d1b5a637a1bf38444b3b20932b.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41247744/29b2b4fc9edb66b1da2b15dab158d10cc9f3cd8a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41247744/564ab01f6512e51db7775d10f1c72e88112d6f16.png[/img] This Game is Crap is finished. With my experience at the time, I logically made a lot of mistakes that would make part 2 more useful. Maybe that will be the next project. I hope you can still surprise someone and have an hour of fun with This Game is Crap.

I thank you

Greetings Marek

http://kck.st/3T6K2GJ

notes.title: Boss-Update
notes.notes:
Finally it's time for the Boss Update is finished Rosa brings has 5 achievements and a lot of lazy tricks. I'm writing my A Levels first and then it's further ahead. Do me a favor until then create peace and play computer games.


*Changelog*

-implemented Steamworks-API
-added 5 Achievements
-fixed multiple Code issues

notes.title: Sorry
notes.notes: Why the new update is taking so long.... My computer broke down and was repaired today and now it will be decided which data is still there.  Don't worry most stuff was backed up.  Unfortunately, I'll be writing my Abitur soon, so let's see what time has to offer.  So as a little apologies next week the game is heavily discounted.

notes.title: Steamworks API
notes.notes: Short update which adds Steamworks APi so that cloud storage and achievments are possible soon. Oh and to make life difficult for friendly people who cracked my game.

notes.title: New Year Update
notes.notes: Shortly after Christmas, the next big update will take place which will add Crap Bosses. Also thank you for the purchases at the sale and for the many who put the game on the wish list.

notes.title: Planned release
notes.notes: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41247744/9a31fc2b811599b0f4c83363609b39b276871160.png[/img]I am pleased to announce that all preparations regarding the paperwork, as well as the configuration with Steam have been completed for the time being. However, this was very time-consuming, which stalled the content expansion of the game. I can still keep the provisional date (game may be coming on October 5th) and now concentrate on the content. The short rest period in terms of further development has also developed some new ideas. ;)
